privileged_info_for_vlm: The official tag is 'Urgent' (case-sensitive, capital U). The tags to be removed and deleted are 'urgent' (lowercase) and 'ASAP' (all caps). Target opportunities are: 'Emergency Generators - Apex Corp' (initially has 'urgent'), 'Rush Order - Beta Industries' (initially has 'ASAP'), and 'Expedited Shipping - Gamma Inc' (initially has both 'urgent' and 'ASAP'). All three must end up with only the 'Urgent' tag, and the two incorrect tags must be deleted from the CRM Configuration > Tags menu.
